fields.label: Opt-In Signing Key
fields.description: HMAC signing key for OTP and magic links. Auto-generated on first use.

fields.label: VAT Taxes and Charges Template
fields.description: Exclusive VAT template applied to all Opt-In quotations, totals, emails, and contracts.

fields.label: Default Terms and Conditions
fields.description: Configured default Terms and Conditions document for standard opt-in and as the fallback for token-based self-onboarding.

fields.label: Allowed Facility Levels for Token Self-Onboarding
fields.description: Enter one HFR Facility Level per line. Matching ignores surrounding whitespace and letter case. Leave blank to allow no facility levels.
When enabled, a completed Opt-In submission creates a contract and immediately sends the Facility Signatory invitation using the existing contract workflow.
fields.label: Automatically Generate and Send Contract
Tiberbu Signatory
fields.description: Tiberbu-side user who co-signs every executed contract. Invited with a 7-day link together with every remaining signatory as soon as the facility signatory has signed; signs via the same OTP + signature-pad portal.

fields.label: Tiberbu signing requirement
fields.options:
All must sign
At least one must sign
fields.description: Controls the Tiberbu Signatory rows below. Facility, witness, and network signatories remain required.

fields.label: Tiberbu signing and approval contacts
fields.description: Add one row per Tiberbu signatory or approver. Contacts can be external and do not need CRM User accounts.

fields.label: Default Tiberbu Signatory Name
fields.description: Default contract signatory name. Use this for an external contact, or leave blank to use the selected User.

fields.label: Default Tiberbu Signatory Email
fields.description: Default contract signatory email. Contact fields take precedence over the legacy User selection.

fields.label: Default Tiberbu Signatory Phone
fields.description: Default contract signatory mobile number for SMS notifications.

fields.label: Tiberbu Approver Name
fields.description: Default approver name for approval notifications. This may be an external contact without a CRM User account.

fields.label: Tiberbu Approver Phone
fields.description: Default mobile number for approval SMS, in international format where possible.

fields.label: Landing Page
fields.description: Shown on the public Tiberbu Express landing page. Leave a field empty to hide its block.

fields.label: DHA Certificate URL
fields.description: Public DHA registry page that verifies the certificate.

fields.label: Contact Phone Numbers
fields.description: One number per line, in international format.
